3.4.1.v: When there is a syntactical relation between the senses of the verbs, the affixes are valid, even in denoting time other than that for which they have been specifically enjoined.

3.4.2.v: When the (frequency of) repetition of an action is indicated, the affix लोट् (Imperative) is added to the root and the verb is repeated. And the affixes हि and स्व or the affixes त and ध्वम् are the substitutes of लोट् (Imperative).

3.4.3.v: The affix लोट् (Imperative) is similarly added to the root optionally when several themes follow one after another.

3.4.4.v: In the first case -- क्रियासमभिहारे लोट्, लोटो हिस्वौ, वा च तध्वमोः [[3.4.2]] the same verb must be used in the subsequent clause, as the verb which was put in the लोट् (Imperative Mood) .

3.4.5.v: In the second case -- समुच्चयेऽन्यतरस्याम् [[3.4.3]], where many actions are spoken of together, the verb that is made to follow, should be such as has the sense common to all those verbs.

3.4.6.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the लुङ् (Aorist), लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) are optionally used in all tenses, in relation to verbs.

3.4.7.v: The affix लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) is optionally used the छन्दस् (Vedas) wherever the लिङ् (Benedictive) can be used.

3.4.8.v: Where a contingent promise (a reciprocal agreement) or apprehension is implied, the affix लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) is used after a root in the छन्दस् (Vedas) Literature.

3.4.9.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following affixes come after the roots with the force of the affix तुमुन् , viz. 1. से 2. सेन् 3. असे 4. असेन् 5. क्से 6. क्सेन् 7. अध्यै 8. अध्यैन् 9. कध्यै 10. कध्यैन् 11. शाध्यै 12. शाध्यैन् 13. तवै 14. तवेङ् 15. तवेन् ।

3.4.10.v: The words 1. प्रयै 2. रोहिष्यै 3. अव्यथिष्यै are irregularly formed Vedic Infinitives.

3.4.11.v: The words 1. दृशे 2. विख्ये are anomalous Vedic Infinitives.

3.4.12.v: The affixes णमुल् and कमुल् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas) to form Infinitives, when they are governed by the verb शक् 'to be able'.

3.4.13.v: The affixes तोसुन् and कसुन् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas) to form Infinitives, when the word ईश्वर is in composition.

3.4.14.v: The affixes 1. तवै 2. केन् 3. केन्य 4. त्वन् are added to roots in the छन्दस् (Vedas), in the sense of कृत्य-affixes.

3.4.15.v: The word of अवचक्षे is an anomalous passive participle in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.4.16.v: The affix तोसुन् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the following verbs, when mere name of the action is indicated viz. 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. इण् 'to go' 3. कृञ् 'to make' 4. वद् 'to speak' 5. चर् 'to go, to walk' 6. हु 'to sacrifice' 7. तम् 'to grow tired' 8. जन् 'to produce' ।

3.4.17.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix कसुन् comes after the verbs 1. सृप् 'to creep' 2. तृद् 'to injure' , in the sense of Infinitives indicating name of action.

3.4.18.v: According to the opinion of the Eastern Grammarians, the affix क्त्वा comes after the verb, when there are in combination with it, the words अलम् and खलु expressing the sense of prohibition.

3.4.19.v: According to the opinion of the Eastern Grammarians, the affix क्त्वा is added to the root मेन् 'to exchange' when the sense is that of interchange, (though the action denoted by the former word is not prior to the action denoted by the latter word).

3.4.20.v: The affix क्त्वा is added to a root, to denote what is situated on the side - पर or on this side of something - अवर।

3.4.21.v: When two actions have the same agent, the affix क्त्वा comes after that verb which takes place in time anterior to that of the other (i.e. Absolutive in त्व refers to that action which precedes in time).

3.4.22.v: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा come after a root when reiteration is to be expressed.

3.4.23.v: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा are not added to a root when the word यद् is used in a simple sentence which does not depend upon another to complete the sense.

3.4.24.v: The affixes णमुल् and क्त्वा come optionally after that verb which denotes the prior action, when both verbs have the same agent, provided that the following words are in composition - 1. अग्रे 2. प्रथम 3. पूर्व।

3.4.25.v: The affix खमुञ् is added to the verb कृ 'to make', when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in construction with it, if the sense intended implies 'abuse'.

3.4.26.v: (When the actions signified by the verbs कृ 'to make' and another have the same agent), the affix णमुल् is added to the verb कृ 'to make' which is concerned about a time anterior to that of the other), provided that a word signifying 'sweet' is in composition.

3.4.27.v: When the words 1. अन्यथा 'otherwise' 2. एवम् 'so' 3. कथम् 'how' 4. इत्थम् 'thus' are compounded with the verb, the णमुल् comes after कृ 'to make', if it be such that its omission would be unobjectionable.

3.4.28.v: The affix णमुल् is added to the root कृ 'to make', the words 1. यथा 2. तथा being compounded with it when an angry reply is made (if the omission of कृञ् is unobjectionable).

3.4.29.v: When the object is compounded with it, the verb दृश् 'to see' or विद् 'to know' takes the affix णमुल् to denote the total number of such objects.

3.4.30.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb विद् 'to know' and जीव् 'to live' when the word यावत् is combined with them.

3.4.31.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुर् 'to fill' when the word चर्मन् and उदर् are compounded with it.

3.4.32.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुर् 'to fill' when the word so formed expresses a measure of rainfall and optionally the long ऊ of this पुर् is elided.

3.4.33.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the causative of the root क्नूय् 'to wet', when there is compounded with a noun denoting 'clothing', in the Accusative -2nd case, as an उपपद , if the whole word so formed expresses a measure of the rainfall.

3.4.34.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words निमूल and समूल are compounded with it in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.4.35.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पिष् 'to grind', when the words 1. शुष्क 'dry' 2. चूर्ण 'powder' 3. रूक्षे 'dry', in the Accusative -2nd case are compounded with it.

3.4.36.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. हन् 'to kill' 2. कृ 'to make' 3. ग्रह् 'to seize', when the words 1. समूल 2. आकृत 3. जीव in the Accusative -2nd case are respectively compounded with them.

3.4.37.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it.

3.4.38.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पिष् 'to grind' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case denoting 'liquid' is in composition.

3.4.39.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs वर्त्ति (the causative of वृत्) and ग्रह् 'to seize' when a word denoting 'hand' in the Instrumental -3rd case, is in composition.

3.4.40.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पुष् 'to feed' when a word in the Instrumental -3rd case having the sense of स्व is in composition.

3.4.41.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the बन्ध् 'to bind' when a word expressing location is in construction with it.

3.4.42.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the बन्ध् 'to bind' when a word so formed denotes an appellative.

3.4.43.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots नश् 'to destroy' and वह् 'to carry' when the words जीव 'life' and पुरुष 'person' expressing the agent of these verbs, are respectively in construction with them.

3.4.44.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots शुष् 'to dry' and पूर् 'to fill' when the word ऊर्ध्व denoting an agent is in composition with them.

3.4.45.v: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when an object or an agent denoting similitude is in composition with it.

3.4.46.v: The same verb should be used after the gerunds formed from the verbs कष् 'to rub' etc. as the verb from which the gerund is derived.

3.4.47.v: The affix णमुल् comes after a root दंश् 'to bite' preceded by the preposition उप when a word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it..

3.4.48.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots having the sense of हिंस 'to injure, to strike' when the object of this gerund is the same as the object of the main verb and when the noun with which it is compounded ends with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix.

3.4.49.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the roots 1. पीड् 'to press' 2. रुद्ध् 'to obstruct' 3. कृष् 'to draw' when they are preceded by the preposition उप and when they are compounded with nouns ending with the Locative -7th case-affix.

3.4.50.v: (The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Locative -7th case or Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it) and when immediate contiguity is intended i.e. 'to fall together by the ears'.

3.4.51.v: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a noun in the Instrumental -3rd case or Locative -7th case is in composition with it and when measure of length is intended.

3.4.52.v: The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a noun in the Ablative -5th case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

3.4.53.v: The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

3.4.54.v: The affix णमुल् comes after a verb when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition, signifying the limbs of one's own body, when the limb is such that its loss will not destroy life.

3.4.55.v: The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case denoting a limb of one's own body, which is completely afflicted by the action, is in composition.

3.4.56.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. विश् 'to enter' 2. पत् 'to fall' 3. पद् 'to pace, to go' 4. स्कन्द् 'to leap', when a word in Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when the sense denoted is that of complete pervasion and total absorption.

3.4.57.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. अस् 'to throw' 2. तृष् 'to be thirsty' when it is intended to express an intermission of the action denoted by the root, provided that a word in the Accusative -2nd case denoting time is in composition.

3.4.58.v: The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. आदिश् 2. ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word नामन् 'name' in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition.

3.4.59.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root कृ 'to make' when an indeclinable word in composition with it and the meaning is the communication of anything in a disagreeable or undesired way.

3.4.60.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root कृ 'to make' when the word त्रियक् is in composition in the sense of 'carrying to the end'.

3.4.61.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', in composition with a word denoting a member of one's own body when the affix तस् is joined thereto.

3.4.62.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', when a word ending in the affix ना -- विनञ्भ्यां नानाञौ नसह [[5.2.27]], or in an affix having the force of धा -- संख्याया विधाऽर्थे धा [[5.3.42]], or having the sense of the affix च्वि 'to make or to become something with it had not been before' -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]], is in composition.

3.4.63.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots भू 'to be', when the word तूष्णीम् 'silently' is in composition.

3.4.64.v: The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् come after the root भू 'to be' when the word अन्वक् in the sense of being favourably disposed, is in composition.

3.4.65.v: The affix तुमुन् is added to every verb when another verb having the sense of 1. शक् 'to be able' 2. धृष् 'to make bold' 3. ज्ञा 'to know' 4. ग्लै 'to be weary' 5. घट् 'to strive' 6. रभ् 'to begin' 7. लभ् 'to get' 8. क्रम् 'to set about' 9. सह् 'to bear' 10. अर्ह् 'to be pleased or to condescend' 11. अस् 'to be'.

3.4.66.v: The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb having in composition with it अलम् and its synonyms when these words express to be capable of something.

3.4.67.v: The affixes called कृत् are used in the sense of an agent.

3.4.68.v: The words 1. भव्य 2. गेय 3. प्रवचनीय 3. उपस्थानीय 4. जन्य 5. आप्लाव्य 6. आपात्य may be optionally be used to denote the agent.

3.4.69.v: The tense affixes called ल are used in denoting the object and the agent and after intransitive verbs, they denote the action as well as the agent.
3.4.69.e: For the सकर्मक verb roots, the लकार can be used in the कर्तरि as well as the कर्मणि sense. For the अकर्मक verb roots, the लकार can be used in कर्तरि as well as भावे sense.
3.4.69.sa: लकाराः सकर्मकेभ्यः धातुभ्यः कर्तरि कर्मणि च भवन्ति । अकर्मकेभ्यः धातुभ्यः कर्तरि भावे च भवन्ति ।
3.4.69.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.70.v: The affixes called कृत्य and the affix called क्त and those that have the sense of खल् have only these last two senses, viz. an action and an object (भाव and कर्म).

3.4.71.v: The affix क्त also denotes the agent when it expresses a beginning of an action.

3.4.72.v: The affix क्त is used in denoting the agent as well as the act and the object after verbs implying motion after intransitive roots and after the verbs 1. श्लिष् 'to embrace' 2. शि 'to lie down' 3. स्था 'to stand' 4. आस् 'to sit' 5. वस् 'to dwell' 6. जन् 'to produce' 7. रुह् 'to mount' 8. जृ 'to grow old'.

3.4.73.v: The word दाश and गोघ्न are irregularly formed and the affix in these denotes the idea of the Dative or Recipient.

3.4.74.v: The words भीम etc. are irregularly formed and denote ablation.

3.4.75.v: The words formed by उणादि affixes denote other ideas other than these two - 1. Reciepient 2. Ablation.

3.4.76.v: The affix क्त which is ordained after roots denoting fixedness (to cling to a place), motion and taking gives the sense of location as well.

3.4.77.v: In the place of ल will be substituted the affixes we shall announce hereafter.
3.4.77.e: All the आदेशs mentioned in this अधिकार happen in place of  लकारs.
3.4.77.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परमस्य पादस्य परिसमाप्तिपर्यन्तमुक्तानि कार्याणि लकाराणाम् स्थाने भवन्ति ।
3.4.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.78.v: The following are the substitutes of ल - तिप् - तस् - झि - सिप् - थस् - थ - मिप् - वस् - मस् - त - आताम् - झ - थास् - आथाम् - ध्वम् - इट् - वहि - महिङ् ।
3.4.78.e: A लकार is initially converted to one of these 18 आदेशाः - तिप्, तस्, झि, सिप्, थस्, थ, मिप्, वस्, मस्, त, आताम्, झ, थास्, आथाम्, ध्वम्, इड्, वहि, महिङ्.
3.4.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.79.v: The substitute ए replaces he last vowel, with the consonant that follows it, of the आत्मनेपद substitutes of that ल which has an indicatory ट्।
3.4.79.e: In case of टित्-लकारs, the 'टि' of the आत्मनेपद प्रत्ययs is converted to 'ए'.
3.4.79.sa: टित्-लकाराणाम् विषये आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्ययस्य टि-संज्ञकस्य ए-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.79.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.80.v: The word से is the substitute of थास् in those tenses that have an indicatory ट्।
3.4.80.e: In case of टित्-लकारs, the आत्मनेपद प्रत्यय थास् is converted to 'से'.
3.4.80.sa: टित्-लकाराणाम् विषये आत्मनेपदस्य थास्-प्रत्ययस्य 'से' आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.80.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.81.v: The words एश् and इरेच् are the substitutes of ट and झ respectively in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).
3.4.81.e: In case of आत्मनेपद of लिट्-लकार, the त-प्रत्यय is converted to एश् and  झ प्रत्यय is converted to इरेच्.
3.4.81.sa: लिट्-लकाराणाम् विषये आत्मनेपदस्य त-प्रत्ययस्य एश्-आदेशः तथा झ-प्रत्ययस्य इरेच्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.81.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.82.v: In the room of the परस्मैपद affixes, the following are substituted in the लिट् (Perfect Tense). Singular - णल् (अ), थल् (थ), णल् (अ). Dual - अतुस् (अतुः), अथुस् (अथुः), व (व). Plural - उस् (उः) , अ (अ), म (म).
3.4.82.e: In case of the लिट् लकार, the परस्मैपद प्रत्ययाः are respectively converted to - णल्,अतुस्, उस्, थल्, अथुस्, अ, णल्, व, म.
3.4.82.sa: लिट्-लकारस्य विषये परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययानाम् णल्-अतुस्-उस्-थल्-अथुस्-अ-णल्-व-म-आदेशाः भवन्ति ।
3.4.82.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.83.v: The above nine affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) are optionally added in the लट् (Present Tense) also after the verb विद् 'to know'.
3.4.83.e: For the verb विद्, the प्रत्ययाः of लिट्लकार are optionally converted (respectively) to णल्,अतुस्, उस्, थल्, अथुस्, अ, णल्, व, म.
3.4.83.sa: विद्-धातोः लट्-लकारस्य विषये  परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययानाम् विकल्पेन  णल्-अतुस्-उस्-थल्-अथुस्-अ-णल्-व-म-आदेशाः भवन्ति ।
3.4.83.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.84.v: Instead of the first 5 tense-affixes in the लट् (Present Tense) coming after the verb ब्रु 'to speak' there may optionally be the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) ; आह being at the same time the substitute in the room of ब्रु 'to speak'.
3.4.84.e: In case of the verb ब्रू, the first five परस्मैपद-प्रत्ययाः of लट्लकार are converted optionally to (respectively) णल्, अतुस्, उस्, थल्, and अथुस्. Also, when this happens, the verb 'ब्रू' is converted to 'आह्'.
3.4.84.sa: ब्रू-धातोः लट्-लकारस्य विषये परस्मैपदस्य आदितानाम् पञ्च प्रत्ययानाम् विकल्पेन णल्-अतुस्-उस्-थल्-अथुस् एते आदेशाः भवन्ति, तथा च ब्रू-धातोः आह्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.85.v: The personal endings of the लोट् (Imperative Mood) are as those of the लङ् (Imperfect Tense).
3.4.85.e: The प्रत्ययाः of the लोट्-लकार are derived in the same way as that of the लङ्लकार.
3.4.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.86.v: In the लोट् (Imperative Mood) उ is the substitute of इ।
3.4.86.e: The इकार present in the  प्रत्ययाs of लोट्लकार is converted to उकार.
3.4.86.sa: लोट्लकारस्य विषये प्रत्ययस्य 'इ' कारस्य उकारः भवति ।
3.4.86.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.87.v: In the लोट् (Imperative Mood) , हि is substituted for सि and this has not the indicatory प् of सिप् , i.e. it is acutely accented.
3.4.87.e: The सिप्-प्रत्यय of the लोट्-लकार is converted to 'हि'.
3.4.87.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.88.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the substitute of हि is optionally treated as not having an indicatory प्।
3.4.88.e: In the context of वेदाः, the 'हि' आदेश given to the सिप्-प्रत्यय of लोट्-लकार could be seen considered as पित्.
3.4.88.sa: वेदानाम् विषये लोट्-लकारस्य सिप्-प्रत्ययस्य 'हि' आदेशः विकल्पेन अपित् भवति ।
3.4.88.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.89.v: In the लोट् (Imperative Mood) नि is substituted for the affix मि।
3.4.89.e: In the context of लोट्लकार, the मिप् प्रत्यय is converted to नि.
3.4.89.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.90.v: In the लोट् (Imperative Mood) आम् is substituted for what would have substituted otherwise ए by टित आत्मनेपदानां टेरे [[3.4.79]].
3.4.90.e: An एकार present in the प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार is converted to आम्.
3.4.90.sa: लोट्-लकारस्य विषये प्रत्यये विद्यमानस्य एकारस्य आम्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.90.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.91.v: For such an ए coming after स् , is substituted व् and for that coming after व् , is substituted अम् , in the (Imperative Mood).
3.4.91.e: An एकार coming after a  सकार  or a  वकार of प्रत्यय of लोट्लकार is respectively converted to व and अम्.
3.4.91.sa: लोट्लकारस्य प्रत्ययेषु विद्यमानस्य सकारात् परस्य एकारस्य 'व' आदेशः तथा वकारात् परस्य एकारस्य अम्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.91.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.92.v: In the लोट् (Imperative Mood) आट् is the augment of the affixes the first person and the termination is as if it had an indicatory प्।
3.4.92.e: The उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार get the आट्-आगम, and this आगम is considered पित्.
3.4.92.sa: लोट्-लकारस्य उत्तमपुरुषस्य प्रत्ययानामाट्-आगमः भवति, सः च पित् वर्तते ।
3.4.92.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.93.v: The ऐ is substituted for ए forming part of the affixes of the first person of the लोट् (Imperative Mood).
3.4.93.e: The एकार occurring in the उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लोट्-लकार is converted to ऐ.
3.4.93.sa: लोट्-लकारस्य उत्तमपुरुषस्य प्रत्ययेषु विद्यमानस्य एकारस्य ऐ-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.93.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.94.v: The augments अट् and आट् are added to the तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.95.v: In the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) ऐ is the substitute of आ in the first and second person dual of the आत्मनेपद ।

3.4.96.v: In the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive) ऐ is optionally the substitute of ए in other places then those mentioned in the last sūtra.

3.4.97.v: In the परस्मैपद affixes the इ is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.98.v: The स् of the first person is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

3.4.99.v: There is always elision of the स् of the first person of the affixes that come in the room of that ल which has an indicatory ङ्।
3.4.99.e: In case of ङित् लकारs, the ending सकार of the प्रत्ययाः of उत्तमपुरुष is removed.
3.4.99.sa: ङित्-लकारेषु उत्तमपुरुषस्य प्रत्ययस्य अन्तिम-सकारस्य नित्यं लोपः भवति ।
3.4.99.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.100.v: And there is elision of the इ of that परस्मैपद affix which is the substitute of a ल having an indicatory ङ्।
3.4.100.e: In case of ङित् लकारs, The इकार present in the परस्मैपद-प्रत्ययs is removed.
3.4.100.sa: ङित्-लकाराणाम् विषये परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्यये विद्यमानस्य इकारस्य लोपः भवति ।
3.4.100.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.101.v: The affixes 1. ताम् 2. तम् 3. त 4. आम् are the substitutes of the four affixes तस् , थस् , थ and मिप् respectively of any ल which has an indicatory ङ् ।
3.4.101.e: In case of ङित्-लकारs, तस्, थस्, थ and मिप् are converted respectively to  ताम्, तम्, त and अम्.
3.4.101.sa: ङित्-लकाराणाम् विषये तस्, थस्, थ, मिप् - एतेषां चतुर्णाम् प्रत्ययानाम् क्रमेण ताम्, तम्, त, अमः - एते आदेशाः भवन्ति ।
3.4.101.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.102.v: The तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लिङ् (Benedictive) and the Potential take the augment स्युत् ।
3.4.102.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.103.v: When the परस्मैपद affixes of the Potential follow, then यासुट् acutely accented, is their augment and the termination is regarded as having an indicatory ङ्।
3.4.103.e: The परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययाः of लिङ्लकार get a 'यासुट्' आगम which is both - उदात्त and ङित्.
3.4.103.sa: लिङ्लकारस्य परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययानामुदात्तः ङित् यासुट् आगमः भवति ।
3.4.103.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.104.v: The augment यासुट् comes after that लिङ् (Benedictive) also which denotes benediction and it is acutely accented and the substitutes of this लिङ् (Benedictive) are as they had an indicatory क्।
3.4.104.e: The परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्ययाः of आशीर्लिङ्लकार get a 'यासुट्' आगम which is both - उदात्त and कित्.
3.4.104.sa: आशीर्लिङ्लकारस्य प्रत्ययानाम् परस्मैपदेषु यासुट् आगमः भवति, स च उदात्तः कित् भवति ।
3.4.104.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.105.v: The affix रन् is the substitute of झ in the लिङ् (Potential and Benedictive).
3.4.105.e: The झ-प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to रन्.
3.4.105.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.106.v: The short अ is the substitute of इ of the आत्मनेपद first person singular in the Potential and Benedictive.
3.4.106.e: The इट्-प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to 'अ'.
3.4.106.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.107.v: The augment सुट् is added to the following affixes त and थ when part of the affixes of the Potential and Benedictive.
3.4.107.e: In case of लिङ्लकार, the तकार and थकार present in the प्रत्ययाः get the 'सुट्' आगम.
3.4.107.sa: लिङ्लकारस्य प्रत्ययेषु उपस्थितस्य तकारस्य थकारस्य च सुट्-आगमः भवति ।
3.4.107.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.108.v: In the Potential and Benedictive जुस् is the substitute of झि , the ending of the first person plural परस्मैपद ।
3.4.108.e: The 'झि' प्रत्यय of लिङ्लकार is converted to 'जुस्'.
3.4.108.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.109.v: (In those tenses which are marked with an indicatory ङ् ) जुस् is the substitute of झि when it comes after an लुङ् (Aorist) in सिच् or the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) of a reduplicated verb or the root विद् 'to know'.
3.4.109.e: The झि-प्रत्यय of a ङित्-लकार that follows सिच्, अभ्यस्त or the verb root विद् is converted  to जुस्.
3.4.109.sa: सिच्-प्रत्ययात् परस्य, अभ्यस्तात् परस्य, तथा विद्-धातुभ्यः परस्य ङित्-लकारस्य  झि-प्रत्ययस्य जुस्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.109.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.110.v: When सिच् is elided जुस् is the substitute of झि after a लुङ् (Aorist) stem which ends in long आ।
3.4.110.e: For an आकारान्त अङ्ग, even  when the सिच् प्रत्यय is removed, the झि-प्रत्यय of a ङित्-लकार is converted to जुस्.
3.4.110.sa: आकारात् अङ्गात् परस्य यः सिच्, तस्य लुकि  अपि तस्मात् परस्य ङित्-लकारस्य झि-प्रत्ययस्य जुस्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.4.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.111.v: In the opinion of शाकटायन only जुस् is the substitute of झि , in the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) of the roots which end in a long आ।

3.4.112.v: In the opinion of शाकटायन only जुस् is the substitute of झि , in the लङ् (Imperfect Tense) after the verb द्विष् 'to hate'.

3.4.113.v: All the personal endings -- तिप्तस्झिसिप्थस्थमिब्वस्मस्तातांझथासाथांध्वमिड्वहिमहिङ् [[3.4.78]], and all affixes with an indicatory श् are called सार्वधातुक ।
3.4.113.e: The तिङ् प्रत्ययs and the शित् प्रत्ययs are called 'सार्वधातुक'.
3.4.113.sa: धातुभ्यः विहिताः तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः तथा शित्-प्रत्ययाः सार्वधातुकसंज्ञकाः सन्ति ।
3.4.113.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.114.v: The remainder i.e. the affixes other than तिङ् (Personal Endings) and those with an indicatory श् sub-joined to a verbal root are called आर्द्धधातुक।
3.4.114.e: Except for तिङ् and शित् प्रत्ययs, other प्रत्ययs that are attached to verbs are called 'आर्धधातुक'.
3.4.114.sa: तिङ्-प्रत्ययं विहाय शित्-प्रत्ययं विहाय च धातुभ्यः विहिताः अन्ये प्रत्ययाः आर्धधातुकसंज्ञकाः भवन्ति ।
3.4.114.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.115.v: The तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) are also called आर्द्धधातुक ।
3.4.115.e: The तिङ्-प्रत्ययs of the लिट्-लकार get the term आर्धधातुक.
3.4.115.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.116.v: When the sense is that of Benediction, the substitutes of लिङ् (Benedictive) are called आर्द्धधातुक i.e. the तिङ् (Personal Endings) of the लिङ् (Benedictive) are आर्द्धधातुक ।
3.4.116.e: The प्रत्ययs of आशीर्लिङ्-लकार are termed आर्धधातुक.
3.4.116.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.4.117.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) this distinction of सार्वधातुक and आर्द्धधातुक is not always maintained and the affixes are promiscuously used.
